text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, young lady. It was so kind of
you to
accompany me all this way...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Don't mention it. You can always count
on
me—I'm Aston Machan, everyone's
lovely mascot.

text_block_list.name: Old Lady
text_block_list.text:
Mahjong... Would you mind speaking a
little
louder?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They go around in circles for some time,
with the continued shouting leaving the
usually
soft-spoken Aston Machan
exhausted.
